    Buying flush doors in Kakinada

    Flush door
    questions.

    For homeowners, carpenters, interior designers, architects and builders. Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp us and we will help you choose.

    What is a flush door?
    A flush door is a flat door with smooth faces over a sturdy engineered core. It has a clean, modern look and can be painted, polished, laminated or veneered.
    How can I finish a flush door?
    Paint or polish it, or cover it with laminate or veneer to match your furniture. We stock laminates and veneers too, so you can choose the door and its finish in one visit.
    Do your flush doors come with a warranty?
    Yes. Liveteck flush doors come with a lifetime warranty and a 100% Gurjan face veneer. Ask our team for the warranty details when you buy.
    How do I get flush door prices?
    Prices depend on the door size and the quantity. Send us your list on WhatsApp (+91 99121 53030) and we will reply with prices and availability.
    Where is your shop in Kakinada?
    We are on Temple Street, beside Pydha Kalyana Mandapam, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. Visit us to see and compare before you buy, or call / WhatsApp +91 99121 53030.
